name: CreatesWowtech AI Content Generator
author: Createswowtech

sections.description:
CreatesWowtech AI Content Generator helps creators, marketers, agencies, and business owners draft high-quality website content without leaving the WordPress admin.

Instead of switching between external writing tools and your editor, you can generate structured drafts for posts and pages, refine them, and save or publish from WordPress. You stay in control of the topic, keywords, tone, language, structure, and final edits — AI speeds up the first draft.

Plugin homepage: CreatesWowtech AI Content Generator

Developed by CreatesWowtech.

How it works

This plugin uses the WordPress AI Client available in WordPress 7.0+. AI providers and credentials are configured once at the site level in WordPress AI settings. The plugin does not store third-party API keys and does not call provider HTTP APIs directly.

Depending on the provider you configure (for example an OpenAI-compatible provider), prompts and related content may be sent to that provider under that provider’s terms. OpenAI is a trademark of OpenAI, Inc. This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.

What you can create

  • Blog posts and long-form articles
  • Landing pages, service pages, and About pages
  • Product and category style descriptions
  • Outlines, FAQs, intros, conclusions, and CTAs
  • Meta titles, meta descriptions, and slugs
  • Optional featured image generation when an image-capable provider is configured
  • Content enrichment (improve or expand an existing draft)

Key features

  • Guided generator for Posts and Pages inside wp-admin
  • Prompt templates (blog, landing page, service page, FAQ, product description, and more)
  • Custom prompt templates with placeholders such as topic, keywords, tone, and audience
  • Tone, style/brand voice, language, and word-count controls
  • SEO-oriented options (meta title/description, slug, FAQ, CTA)
  • Preview, copy, save draft, or publish
  • Gutenberg and Classic Editor generate/enrich integrations
  • Generation history with reuse and review
  • Connection test and status indicators in Settings

Who it is for

  • Bloggers and niche publishers building topic clusters
  • Agencies and freelancers preparing first drafts for clients
  • Small businesses updating service and location pages
  • Store owners drafting product and category copy
  • Marketing teams creating campaign and landing-page text

Suggested workflow

  1. Configure a text-capable AI provider in WordPress AI settings.
  2. Open CreatesWowtech AI Content Generator → Settings and click Test AI Connection.
  3. Go to Generate Content, choose a template, and enter your topic/keywords.
  4. Review the draft, use Enrich Content if needed, then save as draft or publish.
  5. Always fact-check and add your own expertise before going live.

Responsible AI use

Treat generated text as a draft. Verify facts, add original experience, match your brand voice, and publish only content that is accurate and helpful for readers.

External services

This plugin does not call third-party AI provider HTTP APIs directly. Generation requests are sent through the WordPress AI Client (wp_ai_client_prompt).

  • What data may be sent: topic, keywords, audience, tone, style, language, word count, existing content when enriching, and image prompts when generating featured images.
  • When: only when you generate or enrich content, test the AI connection, or generate a featured image.
  • Credentials: managed by WordPress / your chosen provider plugin — not stored by this plugin.

Learn more at CreatesWowtech.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the createswowtech-ai-content-generator folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Install and configure a WordPress AI provider at the site level
  4. Go to CreatesWowtech AI Content Generator → Settings and click Test AI Connection
  5. Start generating content from Generate Content, or use the editor integrations
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key inside this plugin?

No. Configure providers in WordPress AI / provider settings. You are responsible for your provider account, usage limits, and billing.

Which WordPress version is required?

WordPress 7.0 or later is required for the WordPress AI Client.

Who can use this plugin?

Users with the manage_options capability (typically Administrators) can access the generator and settings screens.

Can it write full blog posts?

Yes. The generator can create full post drafts from your topic, keywords, tone, and options. Always review, edit, and fact-check before publishing.

Is the output SEO optimized?

The plugin can generate SEO-oriented structure, headings, meta fields, FAQs, and keyword-focused drafts. Final SEO quality depends on your strategy, editing, internal links, and how well the content matches search intent.

Does it work with my theme or page builder?

The plugin focuses on generating content inside WordPress. It is generally theme-independent. You can paste or publish drafts and then style them with your theme or page builder.

Can I create landing pages?

Yes. Use the page content type and landing/service templates to draft headlines, benefits, FAQs, and calls to action, then edit for your offer and brand details.

Does AI content need human editing?

Yes. Human review is strongly recommended for accuracy, originality, brand voice, and usefulness.

Where can I find documentation and support?

Plugin page: https://www.createswowtech.com/plugin/createswowtech-ai-content-generator/

Contact: https://www.createswowtech.com/contact/

In-plugin help is also available under CreatesWowtech AI Content Generator → Help.
